issue.title: Remove legacy sys.path.append(<src/sase>) import hacks under src/sase/ace/**
issue.description:
Remove the ~13 legacy sys.path.append(<src/sase>) import-time mutations under src/sase/ace/** (status.py, operations.py, revert.py, pr_status.py, archive.py, restore.py, mail_ops.py, handlers/{reword,mail,workflow_handlers}.py, workflows/crs.py, tui/app.py, tui/modals/status_modal.py).

They make every src/sase subpackage importable as a top-level name. This caused Master Gate failure root cause 3 (202609/fix_master_gate_ci.md): tests/tool/test_settlement*.py imported bare `tool._settlement_helpers`, which resolved to src/sase/tool/__init__.py (regular package beats namespace portion) once any earlier-collected test imported the ace modules, breaking full-suite collection with ModuleNotFoundError. The same shadowing can hit production imports of real third-party/top-level modules.

Evidence: probe showed sys.modules['tool'] == src/sase/tool/__init__.py at the failure point; fixed by switching the three test files to `tests.tool._settlement_helpers` imports. That fix is the narrow unblock; this bead is the product-import surgery with its own blast radius, intentionally deferred.

task_type_fields.location: src/sase/ace/status.py, operations.py, revert.py, pr_status.py, archive.py, restore.py, mail_ops.py, handlers/{reword,mail,workflow_handlers}.py, workflows/crs.py, tui/app.py, tui/modals/status_modal.py (sys.path.append at import time)
task_type_fields.repro: Collect the full suite (pytest --collect-only): tests/tool/test_settlement*.py fail with ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'tool._settlement_helpers' because src/sase/tool/__init__.py wins as top-level 'tool' once an ace module is imported. Narrowly unblocked by switching those imports to tests.tool._settlement_helpers; this bead removes the underlying hacks.

issue.creation_reason: Import-time sys.path mutations let src/sase subpackages shadow top-level names; this broke full-suite collection (Master Gate root cause 3) and can shadow production imports.
